source: PriceCharting public console JSON + game-page VGPC.chart_data
priceColumnMeaning: Ungraded / loose raw guide price. Not PSA 10, not SNKRDUNK.
rule: Fixed chase baskets: English Base Set and Base Set 2, Holo Rare + Rare (catalog numbers 1–22 and 70–79, the same cut as market-vintage). Machamp #8 is included only when that printing has a catalog slug. Energy (including Double Colorless #96), commons, uncommons, sealed, and error variants are omitted. Slugs are copied from data/base-psa-pop/catalog.json. Product ids are copied from console JSON.
history: Monthly points from PriceCharting VGPC.chart_data.used (cents → USD). A month needs at least 15 positive prints. Rebase: 2023-01-01 (or the first later thick month) = 1000. No weekly interpolation. No SNKRDUNK.
